subject: Figurative constant values
notes: kb/Work PB110 (2026-08-19): the figurative fill — repeated character by character to the associated item's size, then right-truncated — over a VALUE clause (VAL-FILL3: position 3 of a PIC X(3) VALUE BELL holds the character) and a fixed-length MOVE receiver (MOVE-FILL: position 4 of an X(4)); the ALL-literal fill of PB71's golden is the same rule over a longer literal-1. One node (BoundAllLiteral) carries the semantics for the classic figuratives, ALL literal-1 and the symbolic characters alike.
